results.name: E-01/E-02: Backspace at an element start and Delete at its end join elements; one Undo restores both
E-01/E-02: Delete in an empty element, or Backspace after one, removes only the empty element
E-03: arrow keys move the caret between elements at element boundaries
E-05: Shift+Arrow extends a selection across elements; copy yields typed elements; typing replaces it
E-05: Shift+Click and mouse drag select across elements; Backspace deletes; Escape cancels
E-04: pasting copied elements or screenplay text inserts typed elements, not one paragraph
E-06: Select All selects the element, then the whole script; typing replaces it and Undo restores it
E-06: Escape after Select All returns the caret to where it was, not to the end of the script
E-07: Enter inside bold text keeps the inline style on both halves
D-02/D-03: notes, scene comments and CONT'D never overlap screenplay text
P-01: rows reused across edits keep live handlers (takes, joins and Undo act on the current script)
D-08: take controls, scene numbers and the bookmark ribbon stay clear of text and of each other
D-09: a speech continued on the next page shows its own first line (not the previous page's last line)
no renderer errors during cross-element editing
